summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared email helpers to @fxa/shared/email
description:
Because:
- FxA moves shared code from packages/fxa-shared to Nx libs.
- fxa-auth-server must load the email helpers from one place.

This commit:
- Adds libs/shared/email (@fxa/shared/email) with helpers and TopEmailDomains.
- Ports the mocha helpers test to jest.
- Changes 13 fxa-auth-server files to import @fxa/shared/email.
- Makes the fxa-shared email helpers and topEmailDomains one-line shims.
- Removes email.helpers from the fxa-shared barrel.

Closes FXA-14696
